name: r14-01-status
title: Round 14 @ af962df7: R13-1 fixed; real OSS and a second host hold on the O2 path
subtitle: af962df7 changes only the O2 unstarted branch of hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts (7 lines). Real OSS and second-host runs used 42e2e8b1, the head before it
lines: ## R13-1 fix (af962df7)

++ stored in the Session; after detach + load on a new Harness process the replayed history holds the same text
++ R5-1 refusal in the install window: O2 now shows "Workspace execution was refused before dispatch."
++ real qwen3.8-max, "wait 3 s then print the date": 3/3 in 3 calls, 23-28 s (42e2e8b1: 11 blind calls, 105-114 s)
!! R14-1 (low): reasons over 4096 units are cut at unit 2048 from each end, which can split an emoji into lone surrogates
!!   (seen: U+D83D at 2047, U+DE00 at 2075). Session, Store and DashScope all accepted it; no test reaches this branch

++ 100 MiB + 5 MiB, faults, crash after receipt, 2 x 64 MiB concurrent, preview matrix, real model: exact, every object read back
++ objects private (anonymous GET 403); one flipped bit in a segment -> reads refused, publication fenced + quarantined

== one local-path preview case (F3 band) showed the truncation marker once instead of twice, as in round 7; local path unchanged
note: Nothing here blocks the merge while the profile stays disabled. R13-2 is worth fixing before running against a real bucket; R14-1 is a small follow-up.

name: r14-02-unstarted
title: R13-1 before and after, and where the new head/tail cut splits a surrogate pair
subtitle: Fake model unless marked. "Blocked: sleep 3 followed by: <rest of the command>. ..." comes from the core Shell tool inside the worker
lines: ## What the model sees for an unstarted Shell call
== case                                local path              O2 @ 42e2e8b1                  O2 @ af962df7
++ sleep 3; echo slept                 Blocked: ... (291)      Runtime Shell did not start.   Blocked: ... (291)
++ install-window ownership refusal    Workspace ... refused   Runtime Shell did not start.   Workspace ... refused
++ real qwen3.8-max, wait 3 s + date   2/2, 3 calls            2/2, 11 calls, 105-114 s       3/3, 3 calls, 23-28 s
## Reasons over 4096 UTF-16 units (O2 @ af962df7): slice(0, 2048) + marker + slice(-2048)
++ ~4.9K ASCII                                 -> 4123 units, marker present, 0 lone surrogates
!! emoji high surrogate at index 2047          -> lone U+D83D at 2047
++ emoji at index 2046                         -> pair kept, 0 lone surrogates
!! all emoji                                   -> lone U+D83D at 2047 and lone U+DE00 at 2075 (start of the tail)
== each case: turn completes, Session not blocked, replay on a new Harness process identical
== real qwen3.8-max after reload: request body carried 1-2 escaped lone surrogates, HTTP 200, correct answer
== a 200 KB command is refused earlier on both paths: "Hosted tool input exceeds the inline Session Store limit."
## Suggestion
== cut on code point boundaries, as cutProviderFitSlot in managed-runtime-provider-protocol.ts:572 already does,
== and add a test with a reason over 4096 units (the marker text appears only in the source today)
note: Lone surrogates in tool arguments already block O2 Sessions (#13010). Here the Harness creates them itself; the providers and stores tested accept them, but a stricter consumer may not.
